author: Xu Han
note: Learning/portfolio demonstrator; sky background & filter weighting are engineering_estimate scalings, not a calibrated ETC.

provenance.name: telescope_diameter
provenance.notes: 39.0 m aperture; not a facility prediction.

provenance.name: ifu_spaxel_scale
provenance.url_or_reference: HARMONI image slicer arXiv:1807.06313; MUSE arXiv:astro-ph/0606329
provenance.notes: 10.0 mas spaxel; inspired values, not a reproduction.

provenance.name: sky_spectrum
provenance.notes: Cached SkyCalc-style sky model (radiance + telluric transmission).

provenance.name: source_spectrum
provenance.notes: Cached source spectrum, e.g. CALSPEC/PHOENIX, peak-normalised.

provenance.name: filter_K
provenance.notes: Cached filter curve; original e.g. SVO Filter Profile Service.

provenance.name: filter_throughput
provenance.url_or_reference: SVO 2MASS Ks transmission as a wavelength-dependent bandpass
provenance.notes: Filter curve multiplies the source spectrum (bandpass weighting), not a flat scalar.

provenance.name: sky_background
provenance.notes: Physically-motivated unit conversion; ABSOLUTE level is an engineering estimate (sky_scaling=1.0), NOT a calibrated ETC.

provenance.name: ao_psf
provenance.notes: Strehl-weighted core+halo, Strehl=0.5; no real AO residual model.

provenance.name: ifu_remapping
provenance.url_or_reference: image-slicer proxy (concept: HARMONI arXiv:1807.06313, NIRSpec arXiv:physics/0512002)
provenance.notes: Rectangular slicer with deterministic trace table; not real slicer geometry.

provenance.name: detector_noise
provenance.url_or_reference: H2RG/H4RG-like: MOSFIRE arXiv:1208.0314, NIRSpec arXiv:2208.12686, Rauscher arXiv:1509.06264
provenance.notes: read_noise=8.0 e-, dark=0.005 e-/s; engineering proxies, not real detector cosmetics.

provenance.name: cube_reconstruction
provenance.url_or_reference: controlled inverse mapping (concept: MUSE pipeline arXiv:2006.08638, Horne 1986)
provenance.notes: Nearest + inverse-variance (Horne-like) extraction; not a real pipeline.
